item.title: Mouse Hub 0.2.7
item.description:
Mouse Hub 0.2.7

  • Pages that zoom with the wheel, such as the image viewer in Google Drive, now zoom one step per notch with Smooth scrolling, instead of several.
  • A button whose only setting is Scroll now lets a drag through to the app, so you can pan in Premiere Pro by dragging with the middle button. Holding the button and turning the wheel works as before.
  • Dragging with the middle or side buttons no longer lags when Mouse Hub has nothing to do with the drag, for example in an app where Mouse Hub is off.
  • Switching Spaces now moves one Space at a time, whether you drag or turn the wheel, and the drag follows your hand smoothly from the start.

item.title: Mouse Hub 0.2.6
item.description:
Mouse Hub 0.2.6

  • The guide’s last step in Buttons and Chords no longer disappears when you skip the practice step: it now points at the box where you add one.

item.title: Mouse Hub 0.2.5
item.description:
Mouse Hub 0.2.5

  • A guide to Mouse Hub: right after this update, and the first time Mouse Hub opens on a new Mac, it shows what Mouse Hub does, helps you turn on its two permissions, then walks you through the window step by step. You can try each feature as you go, and skip at any time.
  • Open the guide again any time from the new “?” button next to the layout button, or from Help → Mouse Hub Guide. You can replay all of it or just one part.
  • Hover over any button or setting to see a short note on what it does.
  • The update banner now fits the narrow window.

item.title: Mouse Hub 0.2.4
item.description:
Mouse Hub 0.2.4

  • Update checks always see the newest version right after it is published.

item.title: Mouse Hub 0.2.3
item.description:
Mouse Hub 0.2.3

  • New versions now appear as a banner at the top of the Mouse Hub window, with an Install button, so the update notice can no longer hide behind the window.

item.title: Mouse Hub 0.2.2
item.description:
Mouse Hub 0.2.2

  • Fix: when Mouse Hub finds a new version in the background, the update window now appears reliably.

item.title: Mouse Hub 0.2.1
item.description:
Mouse Hub 0.2.1

Maintenance release: verifies automatic updates. No changes to how Mouse Hub works.

item.title: Mouse Hub 0.2.0
item.description:
Mouse Hub 0.2.0

The first public release.

  • Per-mouse profiles — each mouse gets its own Scroll, Buttons, Chords and per-app settings. Profiles are created automatically when a new mouse is used, and work with two mice at once.
  • Wider speed range — the Speed slider goes from 0.10× to 4.00× on a proportional scale.
  • Compact horizontal layout — the window widens only when Buttons or Chords need it.
  • Automatic updates — Mouse Hub checks daily and asks before installing; also Mouse Hub → Check for Updates…
